title: POV: A customer asks if you have 40 units in stock
caption:
"I think we have 38… maybe 41?"

The most expensive words in inventory. Because "I think" turns into a lost sale, a double order, or a customer who doesn't call back.

Stacko puts every warehouse and branch on one live map. Tap a location, see the stock, answer in seconds.

Tag a stock manager who made this call today, or book a meeting with our team. Link in bio.
